About HydroLux Facial Treatments

The HydroLux Facial is a multi-technology facial designed to meet your ever-changing skin needs. As unique individuals, your skin is unique with its own sets of concerns and requirements. Our skin goes through changes for many reasons, some examples are hormone fluctuations, weather changes, or exposure to different climates as we travel, the causes are as many as our lifestyle demands. As such, your skin can greatly benefit from HydroLux facials that adapt to your changing needs.

Here are our three main protocols:
HydroLux Renewal
Skin Brightening facial focusing on RADIANCE & HYDRATION

All skin types need moisture to function well and achieve natural balance. The HydroLux Renewal facial includes Hydro-Cleanse, an improved vortex infusion technology that effectively cleanses without skin damage. Hydro-Cleanse vacuums out impurities while delivering hydration to the skin, ensuring that your skin gets proper cleansing without drying out. The skin is then infused with a hydrating and brightening ampoule containing concentrated antioxidants. This facial leaves your skin protected and balanced.
HydroLux OxyLift
Skin Tightening facial focusing on LIFTING & YOUTHFUL CONTOURS

Skin loses its firmness over time, this is due to the loss of collagen, and hyaluronic acid, and the self-healing process also slows down. HydroLux Oxylift facial features our exclusive BTX mask which provides immediate firmness and lift, enhancing your facial profile. The BTX mask works by infusing effective ingredients and maintaining a firm hug around the face to create a lifted appearance. Additionally, skin tightening technology is used to further encourage collagen and elastin growth, which improves skin texture and firms the skin. This facial effectively addresses the saggy cheeks, lower face and jawline.
HydroLux Acne Defense
DETOXIFYING facial focused on removing and calming acne-prone skin

There are many causes of acne, such as puberty, hormonal changes or wrong use of products. When treating acne, the first step is to remove clogs and congestions that tend to harbour bacteria. HydroLux Acne Defense includes deep pore cleansing and skin repairing Nano Oxygen Mist. Nano Oxygen brings down inflammation kick-starts healing and kills P-acnes bacteria, to prevent future outbreaks. This acne facial respects your skin, clearing and healing it without drying it out.

HydroLux facials are safe, with no downtime. It focuses on building skin health without invasive methods. As skin needs and concerns change with season and different phases in life, this facial has various modes built in to cater to varying needs, all aim to keep skin healthy, radiant and functioning well.

Frequently Ask Question

Who is HydroLux facial suitable for?

This facial is ideal for all skin types, especially those struggling with:
✔ Dry or dehydrated skin
✔ Clogged pores and congestion
✔ Acne-prone or oily skin
✔ Fine lines and loss of elasticity

How soon will I see results?

Many clients notice immediate improvements in hydration and radiance after just one session. For long-term results, regular treatments are recommended.

Is there any downtime?

No! The HydroLux Facial is gentle, non-invasive, and requires zero downtime, so you can return to your routine right after your session.

Can I wear makeup after the treatment?

It’s best to keep your skin makeup-free for at least 24 hours to allow full absorption of the nutrients and hydration.
